patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: This pain hit my right side out of nowhere and comes in horrible waves — I can't sit still, I keep pacing and squirming. It shoots down into my groin and there's a little blood in my urine.
presentation.triageNote: 40-year-old female with sudden severe right flank pain radiating to the groin in waves. She is pacing and unable to keep still, reports blood in her urine, is afebrile, and rates pain 9/10.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because current guidance treats severe flank pain with marked distress as a high-risk presentation requiring rapid evaluation and pain control.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has sudden severe right flank pain radiating to the groin, hematuria, and inability to remain still.
clinical.acuityReason: The classic colicky pattern and lack of fever are reassuring against overt infection, but pain rated 9 of 10 with marked distress should not wait for routine resource sorting.
expectedResources: Rapid IV analgesia and antiemetic medication
keyFindings: Pacing and unable to remain still
redFlags: Severe flank pain with marked distress
teachingPoints: Fever with obstruction raises concern for an infected urinary system requiring urgent drainage.
Stable vital signs do not override severe current distress.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid symptom control and imaging would guide discharge after improvement or admission and urologic intervention for infection, renal injury, or high-risk obstruction.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: restless, half-standing, clutching her right flank
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 40-year-old woman, restless beside a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: half-standing, clutching her right flank, unable to get comfortable. Expression: anguished, writhing. Clearly visible: a hand clutching the flank and a restless, pained posture. No text, no logos.
